# AttendStack

> AttendStack is an enterprise-grade cloud Workforce Management (WFM) and Human Resource Management System (HRMS) platform developed by Bhatt Square Pvt. Ltd. It unifies biometric and GPS geofenced attendance, multi-shift scheduling, leave entitlements, payroll processing, and employee self-service (ESS) into a single operational workspace.

## Core Capabilities & Features

### 1. Attendance & Geofenced Time Tracking
- Real-time punch-in and punch-out with geofencing radius validation and IP restriction.
- Automated absent marking on working days with protection for Sundays and configured company holidays.
- Auto-checkout support for employees who forget to clock out at the end of their shift.

### 2. Multi-Shift Management & Grace Periods
- Multi-shift scheduling supporting standard day shifts, split shifts, and rotational night shifts.
- Granular grace periods: configurable late arrival grace (e.g. 15 minutes) and early departure cutoff grace.
- Automated deduction policies: Pro-rated hourly deduction or Half-Day salary deduction for early checkouts.
- Minimum working hours thresholds for half-day credit (e.g., 4 hours) and full-day credit (e.g., 8 hours).

### 3. Employee Directory & Profile Lifecycle
- Full employee lifecycle records from onboarding to offboarding.
- Department, designation, and reporting manager supervisory hierarchy.
- Document repository supporting verified identity proofs (PAN card, Aadhaar card, CV, and profile photos).
- Employment standing status tracking: Active, Provision, On Leave, Notice Period, Inactive, and Terminated.

### 4. Leave Policy & Entitlement Engine
- Paid leave categories: Casual / Privilege Leave (PL), Sick Leave (SL), Maternity Leave, Paternity Leave, Bereavement Leave, and Marriage Leave.
- Prorated leave balance calculations based on joining month for first-year employees.
- Annual entitlement override capabilities for specialized contract employees.
- Sandwich rule and burger rule automated leave deductions for unapproved absences around weekends or public holidays.

### 5. Payroll, Statutory Compliance & Payslips
- CTC salary structuring and automated monthly gross calculations.
- Direct bank deposit records with IFSC and bank account validation.
- Indian statutory registration tracking: Tax ID / PAN Number, Provident Fund (PF), Universal Account Number (UAN), and ESIC Number.
- PDF payslip generation and employee compensation breakdown.

### 6. Company Rulebooks & Holidays
- Organization-wide holiday calendars.
- Public rulebooks ensuring transparent company attendance and leave guidelines.

## Publisher & Company Information

- Web Platform: https://attendance.nextgenapplication.com
